::: {.contact-section}

Whether you're just starting to plan your study or you're staring at a dataset wondering what to do next, I'd be happy to hear from you. The first consultation is free, so there's no risk in reaching out.

You don't need to have your statistics figured out before making contact. That's literally what I'm here for.

[Email me about your project](mailto:vantwiska@gmail.com?subject=Statistical%20Consulting%20Inquiry&body=Name:%0D%0AProgram%20or%20affiliation:%0D%0ABrief%20project%20description:%0D%0AWhere%20you%27re%20at%20(proposal%2C%20data%20collection%2C%20analysis%2C%20writing%20up):%0D%0ATimeline%20or%20deadlines:){.btn-cta .btn-cta-large}

::: {.what-to-include}

### What to include in your email

- Your name and affiliation (e.g. PhD candidate, University of Cape Town)
- A brief description of your research project
- Where you're at in the process (proposal, data collection, analysis, or writing up)
- Any deadlines you're working toward

:::

::: {.what-happens-next}

### What happens next

We'll set up an initial consultation to get an overview of your project, what you're working on, your objectives, and what you're hoping to achieve. This helps me understand where you are and figure out how I can best support you. No obligations, no jargon.

:::

:::
